description: This PHP source file contains utility functions related to handling logic hooks for modules within the SuiteCRM project. It provides functions to load, check, modify, and write logic hook configurations, with some functions facilitating file operations and hook array manipulations.

methods.name: get_hook_array
methods.description: Loads and returns the array of logic hooks for a given module by including the module's logic_hooks.php file if it exists.

methods.name: check_existing_element
methods.description: Checks if a specific action, identified by $action_array[1], already exists within the hook array for a specific event.

methods.name: replace_or_add_logic_type
methods.description: Builds a PHP code string containing the logic hook array and wraps it in PHP tags for inclusion or writing to a file.

methods.name: write_logic_file
methods.description: Creates or updates the logic_hooks.php file for a specific module with new hook configuration contents.

methods.name: build_logic_file
methods.description: Constructs the PHP code for the logic hooks array, including versioning and hooks definitions, from a given hook array.
